newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tonnes of South African marijuana go up in smoke.
newsitem.headline: Tonnes of South African marijuana go up in smoke.

text.p: South African police have burned 15 tonnes of marijuana seized in a remote area of KwaZulu-Natal province.
A police statement said the crime-busting operation in the Tugela Ferry area also netted 14 firearms, including two AK-47 assault rifles.
But no suspects were caught because they saw police coming across the rugged landscape and fled.
The drug had a street value of about 15 million rand ($3.3 million), police said.
Economists say marijuana, although illegal, is a big contributor to incomes in some of the poorest and remotest parts of the country.
